text:
maria: quick heads-up — noticed NDCG drop on embeddings rerank after quantize bring-up for model-xyz. numbers: -4.2% on msmarco subset. anyone see this?
ajay: interesting. is this only quantized vs fp? or also variant-by-variant?
maria: comparing fp16 baseline -> int8 quant. The eval harness runner shows many zero vectors for some queries. quick grep shows 'all zeros' in embeddings output for shard 7.
kevin: can you paste the runner log? might be KVCACHE prefix trimming bug.
maria: https://ci.redwood/exp/17498/logs — here's the snippet
```
[runner] produce_embedding: shape=(64,768) dtype=float32
[runner] quantize_to_int8: output[12] = [0,0,0,...]
```
sophie: that's bad. we had a prior bug where padding_mask was misaligned after TPU->GPU conversion.
ajay: hmm this is on CPU quant pipeline right? or using the new fastquant kernel?
maria: fastquant. reproducer: run eval-harness --model model-xyz --quantize int8 --dataset ms-marco --shard 7
kevin: can you run with --dump-raw and upload the .npy? I want to check whether it's pre-quantization zeros or post.
maria: uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/embeddings/1749801234/shard7_dump.npy
eval-bot: test-runner/1749801280 completed: 1 failing test (embedding_zero_vector_resilience) — see logs
sophie: I ran quick check: pre-quantization vectors are non-zero; zeros only appear after quantization kernel. maybe underflow or clash with per-channel scaling if max==0 for that channel.
ajay: that could happen if the per-channel max is computed from int8 outputs incorrectly when shard has repeated identical vectors — leads to scale=0 -> all zeros after int8->float dequant.
kevin: PR idea: clamp scale to eps and add fallback to global scale when computed max < 1e-8. also log channel stats if scale near zero.
maria: willing to prototype. will open a tiny PR against fastquant and add unit test for 'constant-vector shard' -> ensure dequant outputs non-zero close to original fp values.
ajay: also add a CI runner job with small-msmarco shard to catch this in future.
sophie: add a metric-level alert: if fraction of zero vectors > 0.1% during eval, fail the job. Prevent silent regressions.
kevin: +1 for both. i'll review the PR.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood/fastquant/pull/312 — includes clamp + unit test. added debug log: quant_scale_min=1e-6
ajay: merged after minor nit. deployed to staging quant-kernel v2
eval-bot: deployment/staging completed: fastquant v2
maria: re-ran harness on shard 7 -> NDCG back to baseline within noise (+0.2%). closing the loop. :tada:
